summary: xsaveprobe's report, judged as etude will under the processor profile max, and the two frame host tests, with faults in fpu.c's XSAVE code; the base phase also requires the judge to refuse the report of a processor without XSAVE and AVX

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 tests krffs test-image build/tools/etude/casecheck build/tests/system/harness && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel images/test.krffs
sh tests/proofs/xsave.sh max "$1" && { [ "$2" != base ] || sh tests/proofs/xsave.sh qemu64 "$1"; }

faults.name: switch
faults.summary: the context switch saving x87 and SSE alone, so the upper halves of the YMM registers are lost

lines: assert xcr0 fail: XCR0 is not x87, SSE, and AVX

faults.name: magic1
faults.summary: the signal frame's FP_XSTATE_MAGIC1 left zero

lines: assert signals fail: the handler: the frame's software bytes lack FP_XSTATE_MAGIC1

faults.name: ucflags
faults.summary: the signal frame's UC_FP_XSTATE flag left out

lines: assert signals fail: the handler: the frame's uc_flags lack UC_FP_XSTATE

faults.name: sigreturn
faults.summary: sigreturn dropping the YMM state from XSTATE_BV

lines: assert signals fail: after a handler that clobbered the registers: ymm0: the upper half

faults.name: view
faults.summary: the XSAVE view ptrace reads without XCR0 at byte 464

lines: assert ptrace fail: NT_X86_XSTATE does not have XCR0 at byte 464
fail: the view has XCR0 at byte 464

faults.name: magic2
faults.summary: sigreturn taking an extended frame without FP_XSTATE_MAGIC2

faults.name: header
faults.summary: sigreturn taking an XSAVE header whose reserved bytes are set

lines: fail: a frame with XCOMP_BV set is refused
